main.description: Council Lv6+ Charter Compliance attestation (≥3 signers required). Per ADR-2605192230. Established by aggregating ≥3 charter-counsel-vote records; resolved to on-chain ChartersComplianceRegistry tx after 30-day appeal window.

requestUri.description: AT URI of the originating charter-attestation-request record.

determination.description: Council ruling. 'non-aligned' triggers L1+L2+L3 enforcement; 'aligned' clears; 'insufficient-evidence' invites re-filing with new evidence.

violationCategory.description: Confirmed Rider §2 sub-section. Required if determination = non-aligned.

rationaleCid.description: IPFS CID of full deliberation rationale (markdown / PDF).

councilSigners.description: DIDs of Council Lv6+ members who signed.

councilSignatures.description: DID-bound signatures over the canonical attestation digest (base64url).

voteUris.description: AT URIs of the ≥3 charter-counsel-vote records that constituted quorum.

registryTxHash.description: ChartersComplianceRegistry.attestNonAligned* tx hash on Base L2 (set after on-chain finalize).
